description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, and Pi
summary: The interesting engineering here is the single-Markdown-source model: one definition of a skill or agent gets compiled into the right format for whichever coding harness you're on, from Claude Code's plugin marketplace to Codex's TOML agents to Copilot's generated profiles. That cross-compile layer for prompt components is the kind of abstraction that removes the copy-paste toil I run into in PenguPool when I route sessions across different runtimes, and the capability matrix documenting what each harness actually supports versus what it fakes with shims is a genuinely useful reference. The 94-plugin catalog is less the point than the fact that you can now treat "agent instructions" as a portable artifact rather than a per-tool rewrite.
